value.name: Asha stops on the half-landing
value.description: Asha halts on the stair landing, holding the blue folder against the bank statements as she looks down toward Daniel.
evidence: At the half-landing Asha stopped, the blue folder pressed flat against the bank statements at her side, and looked down past the runner to where Daniel still stood

value.name: Asha confronts Daniel about the changed will
value.description: Asha asks Daniel why he did not tell her that someone changed it four months before death, implying a concealed alteration of the will or document.
evidence: "Why didn't you tell me she changed it four months before she died," she said, not as a question

value.name: Daniel hesitates to respond
value.description: Daniel twitches at his neck and swallows his reply, leaving his prepared words unsaid.
evidence: Daniel's hand twitched at his neck and did not lower; whatever he had readied to say stayed behind his teeth

value.name: Rosa finishes folding the towel
value.description: Rosa completes folding the towel and sets it on the table before speaking.
evidence: Rosa, without turning her head, finished the second fold of the towel and laid it on the table

value.name: Rosa rebukes Daniel
value.description: Rosa tells Daniel that the time for smiles is over, signaling a hardening of the situation.
evidence: "The time for smiles is over, Daniel."
